value.rationale: Exact degree-ell harmonic data arise in frequency-isolated spherical acquisitions. The theorem gives the least number of distinct absolute latitude levels required by any positive tight acquisition, constructs an all-northern tight grid attaining it, and classifies all interior minimal radial patterns with an explicit rigidity/family parity split. These are exact infinite-family structural facts with a practical sampling-resource meaning, not an arbitrary slice, a known-table recomputation or a marginal numerical improvement. The outcome does not claim global point-number optimality.
